rationale: The filer tags the closing fair value in its affiliate roll-forward note with the investment identifier axis, using the issuer name alone. Those facts enter holdings as extra positions beside the schedule rows they repeat. Schedule rows always name the instrument after the issuer and carry principal, units or a percent of net assets; roll-forward rows carry none of the three. The rule is structural and covers every quarter, so it does not have to be re-authored when a new filing arrives. Known residual: at 2025-09-30 one further non-schedule fact ('Blue Owl Cross-Strategy Opportunities LLC (BOCSO)', 24,600,000, context c-954, carrying a percent value) is not selected; it is inside the conservation band and is left for review.
